keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: What to search for on AliExpress, one search per keyword (e.g. "wireless earbuds", "phone case"). Each result page has about 60 products.

searchUrls.title: Search URLs
searchUrls.description: Optional. AliExpress search or category result URLs, with any filters you set on the site, e.g. https://www.aliexpress.com/w/wholesale-phone-case.html?SortType=total_tranpro_desc. Not product pages (put those in Product IDs).

maxPagesPerKeyword.title: Max pages per search
maxPagesPerKeyword.description: Result pages to read per keyword / search URL (about 60 products per page; AliExpress stops at 60 pages).

sort.title: Sort by
sort.description: Result order. Ignored for search URLs that already contain a SortType.

includeReviews.title: Scrape reviews for search results
includeReviews.description: Also fetch buyer reviews for the top products of each search (see "Reviews for top N products").

reviewsForTopProducts.title: Reviews for top N products
reviewsForTopProducts.description: Fetch reviews for the first N products of each search. 0 = every product found.

productIds.title: Product IDs or URLs (reviews only)
productIds.description: Optional. Products to fetch reviews for, without searching: item IDs (1005007502032342) or item URLs (https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005007502032342.html).

maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product
maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Stop after this many reviews per product (20 per request).

translateReviews.title: Translate reviews
translateReviews.description: Ask AliExpress for machine translations into the Language below (returned in translatedText). AliExpress then prefers reviews from buyers in the ship-to country, and dates may be localized.

shipTo.title: Ship to country
shipTo.description: Two-letter country code (US, GB, DE, FR, BR, ...). Prices, availability and delivery estimates depend on it. EU/UK searches return fewer fields (no rating or sold count) because AliExpress shows lean cards there.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter currency code for prices (USD, EUR, GBP, BRL, ...).

language.title: Language
language.description: Two-letter language for titles and review translations (en, de, fr, es, pt, ...).

onlyNew.title: Only new items (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Return only products and reviews not returned by an earlier run with the same searches, product IDs, sort and ship-to country. Schedule the actor (e.g. daily) for new-listing and new-review alerts: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new items. Reviews stop after pages with nothing new. State is kept in the key-value store "aliexpress-scraper-state" in your account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. By default the actor connects directly and switches to Apify datacenter proxy automatically if AliExpress starts blocking. Set a proxy here to always use it.
